eyebrow: AGENDA · NOVEMBER 5 · ALL TIMES PST / CET
heading: Three hours. All live.

sessions.title: Kelsey Hightower
sessions.description: A conversation on how inference is changing infrastructure, what platform teams should build now, and what the community should avoid repeating.

sessions.title: Serving Inference at Scale
sessions.description: How do you serve models fast, reliably, and at scale? Maintainers behind NVIDIA Dynamo, KServe, Envoy AI Gateway and Modelplane break down the inference stack layer by layer, from routing requests to running the engine.
sessions.meta: Itay Neeman, NVIDIA · Erica Hughberg, Tetrate · Filippe Spolti, Red Hat · Dennis Ramdass, Upbound · 30 min

sessions.title: Building the Platform for AI
sessions.description: Running inference at scale starts with the platform underneath. Maintainers and contributors from Kubernetes, Metal3, Crossplane and Modelplane discuss how the cloud native ecosystem is evolving to orchestrate AI infrastructure, from the cloud to bare metal.
sessions.meta: Nina Polshakova · Kashif Nizam Khan, Ericsson · Shivay Lamba, Qualcomm · Nic Cope, Upbound · 30 min

sessions.title: Running Inference in Production
sessions.description: Getting a model running is the easy part. Practitioners share what it takes to operate inference in the real world, from observability and cost to the challenges enterprise teams face every day.
sessions.meta: Julia Furst Morgado, Dash0 · Karan Nisar, CoreWeave · Dennis Ramdass, Upbound · 30 min

sessions.title: Viktor Farcic
sessions.description: A practical look at the emerging AI inference stack and what cloud native and platform engineers need to know.
